analysis.title: GS flow and positioning observations
key_insights: Nvidia beat and raised: guided about $130bn vs roughly $125bn expected, with zero China data center compute in the numbers. Stock +3% after hours on the better quarter and guide plus a $150bn additional buyback. The NVIDIA board chair said the firm does not plan to reinstate Huang.
Tech-related markets were recovering off the lows. Kospi held the lows of the prior sell-off and was +2%. SK Hynix trades on 1.79x blended 24-month P/E (Bloomberg).

Prior-day tape rotation: high beta momentum up, AI outperformed AI losers, the short leg of momentum was hit. Expensive defensives caught down alongside small and mid cap cyclicals. The desk read the gross positioning move as somewhat constructive.

Cyber anxiety: Privorotsky argues there is no evidence the clustered outages were related or caused by hackers (WIRED), and thinks anxiety on the topic has hit local highs. Costco sold out of 21 of 26 high-ticket generator models online by Sunday. The NSA later said the network outages were linked to software updates.

APEC: Trump and Xi are due to meet Thursday in Shenzhen, with Putin reportedly joining a separate three-way conversation. Privorotsky is watching whether the trade truce holds after new US chip curbs, and is bearish on a near-term Russia/Ukraine ceasefire after reports Ukraine hit the Kerch Bridge span.

Oil: the US hit an Iranian missile launch site Tuesday after Iran said it targeted a US radar installation in Bahrain. Oman and Qatar are still talking to Tehran. The US 3-2-1 crack spread is down 36% in six weeks, from $65.56 to $41.90/bbl. API showed US crude and gasoline stocks each building about 5m barrels.

Metals: London copper near 5m lows, Shanghai testing 100k, gold cannot hold a bounce even with lower yields. Privorotsky suggests a possible liquidation element in gold and that commodities may signal policy is too tight in China.

Technicals: CTA selling velocity may have peaked but the magnitude can still be considerable, especially in Europe. Spot gamma remains very level dependent. SPX is holding the 200-day by a fingernail. Nasdaq broke early-month lows intraday and recovered into the close.

Privorotsky is starting to turn contrarian on AI: given the dollars still to be spent, the multiple compression and what is being paid for defensives, some names could rise quickly. He likes long front-end bonds alongside equities, and reads the commodity declines (copper, crude, gasoline, diesel, parts of grains) as a potentially meaningful disinflationary impulse if sustained.

US close: S&P -103bps at 7,340 with a $2.4bn MOC to sell, NDX -7bps at 27,001, R2K -139bps at 2,703, Dow -164bps at 50,759. VIX +1061bps at 25.34. Volume 18.855bn shares vs 18.557bn YTD average. Floor activity 3 out of 10, asset managers net sellers led by large cap tech, hedge fund flows balanced.
NKE finished -6% (from +3% intraday) on its investor day as investors were deeply skeptical of the 2031 guide.

New tech regulation themes: restrictions on China's access to high-end AI chips (including renting NVDA chips outside the US), a Reuters report that the Trump administration plans to block imports of Chinese data center equipment, and an NVDA board committee for national security and export control.

Derivatives: the desk expects NVDA earnings and VIX expiry to remove significant vol premium as dealer short tails roll off. GS customers bought 14k VIX 16Dec 19/16 put spreads, and clients traded SPX term structure on the view front-end vols are too rich. The S&P implied move through tomorrow is 1.26%.

tension_points.bull_case: Sheer dollars still to be spent on AI, multiples have compressed, and people are paying up for defensives. NVDA beat and raise with a $130bn guide and no China data center compute included.
tension_points.bear_case: Haircut 2028 spending and worry about a 2029 peak. Cheap names getting cheaper raises earnings sustainability concerns.
tension_points.what_invalidates: SPX failing to hold the 200-day, which closed below at 7,344 on the day, and CTA selling extending, especially in Europe.

tension_points.bull_case: Falling copper, crude, gasoline, diesel and grains are a meaningful disinflationary impulse if sustained, supporting long front-end bonds.
tension_points.bear_case: One day is not a trend in rates, and supercore inflation can be debated.
tension_points.what_invalidates: The commodity declines failing to stick.
